ruleDefinitions.name: Disable Internal Tools or Feature in Registry
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects registry modifications that change features of internal Windows tools (malware like Agent Tesla uses this technique) Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (((registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\DisableCMD$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\NoControlPanel$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\NoRun$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\StartMenuLogOff$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System\\\\DisableChangePassword$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System\\\\DisableLockWorkstation$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System\\\\DisableRegistryTools$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System\\\\DisableTaskmgr$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System\\\\NoDispBackgroundPage$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System\\\\NoDispCPL$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\Explorer\\\\DisableNotificationCenter$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\System\\\\DisableCMD$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)") OR ((registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System\\\\ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin$") OR registry_path = RGX("Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System\\\\InactivityTimeoutSecs$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\System\\\\shutdownwithoutlogon$") OR registry_path = RGX("SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\PushNotifications\\\\ToastEnabled$") OR registry_path = RGX("SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\Storage\\\\Write\\ Protection$") OR registry_path = RGX("SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\StorageDevicePolicies\\\\WriteProtect$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)"))
